name: pr-autopilot
description: Watches your open pull requests: CI pass/fail toasts, failing-check logs attached when you mention them, a prs_status tool so Claude reads them without gh, and the post-merge ritual (fetch --prune, switch, ff-only pull, delete the branch) done for you with no model calls. Tells you once when gh's token cannot read checks.

pollSeconds.title: Check PRs every (seconds)
pollSeconds.description: How often each watched open PR's state and CI checks are read with gh.

authRetryMinutes.title: Retry gh after an auth error (minutes)
authRetryMinutes.description: When gh cannot read the checks (a fine-grained token without "Checks: read") or the PRs (not logged in), how long before the full read is tried again. The PRs are still polled without their checks meanwhile, and /prs retries at once.

deleteRemoteBranch.title: Delete the remote branch after a merge
deleteRemoteBranch.description: Also delete the PR's branch on origin once it is merged, when it still points at the merged head. GitHub's "Automatically delete head branches" setting is the recommended way.

attachCiLogs.title: Attach CI logs when you mention a failing PR
attachCiLogs.description: When your prompt mentions a failing PR ("#258 failed checks", "CI failed"), attach gh pr checks and the tail of the failed run's log for Claude.

logLines.title: Failed log lines to attach
logLines.description: How many lines from the end of the failed run's log are attached.
